measurement_semantics: Whole bounds include every authored vertex after grounding. Every leaf has stored construction frame: local longitudinal span=max/min dot with base-to-tip unit vector; transverse span=max/min dot with in-plane perpendicular. Both include all tips and caps. Lamina thickness is nominal material thickness between paired top/bottom surfaces, NOT total curved/folded normal bbox; shallow folding is allowed. Primary fossil size ranges are compatible design limits, not specimen replication.
